title: Merchandise labels
slide_intent: Teach designers to separate venue, item and parent institution even on a small tag that someone reads in the hand.
strategic_value: The museum can give a shop item a specific Abbeydale identity while linking it to the wider organization.
demonstration: A brown hanging tag stacks the Abbeydale Industrial Hamlet mark, the throw’s name, material and dimensions, and a smaller Sheffield Museums seal.
practical_value: Group the descriptive product details between the venue mark and the parent seal so the shopper can read all three at different scales.

content_islands.name: Hanging tag
content_islands.spec: Enlarge the brown tag against white space with the cord entering from the upper edge.

content_islands.name: Label hierarchy
content_islands.spec: Set the venue mark in white at the top. Center the wool throw’s description below and finish with the circular museum seal at the foot.
